column1: # Guitar Rig 6 'Tremolo' rack component (NI::DSP::RigTremolo), headless. Regenerate: tools/measure_gr6.sh <outdir>
# one row = python3 tools/gr6state.py gr6_default.aupreset ngrc_Tremolo_doc0.xml Tremolo st.aupreset Rt=<r> Int=<i> Up=<u> Dn=<d> Wdt=<w> Rack.G=0
# probe: python3 $RE/sig.py gen sine sine3k_m18.wav --freq 3000 --db -18 --secs 12   (gain 1.0 = input level; rise/fall = 10-90 % of the swing)
# A rate curve: Rt sweep (Int=1 Up=0 Dn=0 Wdt=0.5)
# B depth: Int sweep (Rt=0.5 Up=0 Dn=0)
# C edges: Up sweep (Rt=0.5 Int=1 Dn=0), then Dn sweep (Up=0)
# D width: Wdt sweep (Rt=0.5 Int=1 Up=0 Dn=0)
# E factory INIT preset (Rt=0.500057 Int=0.5 Up=0.5 Dn=0.5 Wdt=0.5), one cycle
# F input level: Rt=0.5 Int=0.75 Up=0.5 Dn=0.5 at -6, -18, -36 dBFS
# G stereo: Pan=1 (Rt=0.5 Int=0.75 Up=0.5 Dn=0.5), stereo probe, channel 0 then channel 1
